verdict.rationale: Paddle documents an overlay checkout that "handles all parts of the checkout process — minimal frontend coding required" via Paddle.js, plus an embeddable inline checkout, so developers avoid building payment UI. However, both are presented on the merchant's own site rather than as a redirect to a standalone vendor-hosted page, and nothing in the evidence backs the "conversion-optimized" claim. Missing for 10: an explicit hosted checkout page or redirect/payment-link flow, evidence of conversion optimization, independent or hands-on corroboration.
